title: Vampire Vape Blood Sukka Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Blood Sukka by Vampire Vape offers a vibrant combination of succulent cherries, summer berries, and luscious red fruits. This bold-tasting fruit blend is enriched with the sweet, smooth essence of eucalyptus and punchy aniseed. Furthermore, the fruity concoction is elevated by a menthol burst, providing a cool and refreshing throat hit with every inhale. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production, and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. These Vampire Vape Nic Salt e-liquids are perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts along with a super-smooth throat hit. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than high-strength freebase liquids are capable of. With nicotine salt e-liquids, the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings.
